notes.title: Today we take you to the heart of Lionport – where wealth and power are forged!
notes.content:
[p]Welcome to a new Dev.Log for "[i]The Trade Dynasty"[/i]!

Today, we’ll take you to the very heart of [b]Lionport[/b] – where wealth and power are forged: 
the [b]Marketplace[/b] and the [b]Town Hall[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]💰 [b]On the Marketplace[/b], life is bustling. Merchants sell their wares, caravans arrive, and deals are struck – or lost. This is where your fortune grows… or fades.[/p][p][/p][p]🛡️ [b]In the Town Hall[/b], not only the city’s fate is decided. 
Laws are debated, alliances forged, and political careers launched. 
Influence here means power far beyond gold.[/p][p][/p][p]✨ Over the past weeks, we have fundamentally reworked the graphics of "[i]The Trade Dynasty"[/i]. 
Not just specific locations, but the entire game world has been improved – with the goal of making atmosphere and detail even more tangible and delivering a more immersive experience.[/p][p]At the same time, we are approaching the end of the [b]technical alpha[/b] and preparing the port to the final game engine – a major step in development that we want to take together with you. 
Of course, we will continue to keep you updated here.[/p][p]In addition, we’d like to share a special insight: the [b]blueprint of Lionport’s Town Hall[/b]. :-)

It shows how architecture and planning take shape in the game – before you can experience it in all its glory as a player.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45702614/fcc8a1e3d66d82a4a533a5c4c37c7fa4c9befedd.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45702614/29422cbb183e086391ef4e71aa38a79b03deec7c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45702614/3f8397a17034f41d2b5d078a776098cda4138320.png"][/img][/p][p]That’s it for todays dev.Log!
We’d love to hear your thoughts – will you start your journey trading at the market, or rise to power in the Town Hall?
[/p][p]Your Dogfoot Games Team[/p]

notes.title: 🔧 Dev Log #1 – Arrival at Hammerfield
notes.content:
[p][b]Today we arrived in Hammerfield...[/b][/p][p]…a small, yet wealthy town nestled between dense forests, rocky cliffs and the ever-present scent of iron and smoke.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45702614/573507c6bf77e4827193ce872bed1f7da3f0d4f8.png"][/img][/p][p]Even before docking, one can feel it: This is a place of craft, grit – and trade.[/p][p]Hammerfield thrives on mining, smithing, and a surprisingly well-run sheep farming industry.
Between the ringing of hammers and the bleating of wool, you’ll find proud faces and artisans who won’t sell cheap – but always fair.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45702614/f9a981b2d904edac4b4ef50babe057aea2bfa9d7.png"][/img]
The city is surrounded by sturdy walls, with a twin-towered gate that watches every cart and traveler. Security and structure are taken seriously here.[/p][p]This first screenshot gives you a glimpse into the current layout of Hammerfield.
[/p][p]More views – including its outskirts and production sites – are coming soon.[/p][p]Stay tuned![/p]
